changes.title: Kennedy Center says it's on the brink of bankruptcy, might close as early as Tuesday
changes.summary: In two board resolutions made public Monday, the arts institution says it is in a dire financial and physical state — and that only President Trump can "rescue" it. (Image credit: Alex Wroblewski).

changes.title: Kennedy Center board to propose new options for honoring Trump, according to court filing
changes.summary: The document proposes 10 options for adding the president's name to the building's exterior.

changes.title: News Wrap: Kennedy Center warns of 'fiscal collapse' without Trump's name on building
changes.summary: In our news wrap Monday, officials at the Kennedy Center are warning of "certain fiscal collapse" unless President Trump's name is added to the exterior of the building, several state election officials tell the News Hour they are bracing for uncertainty over mail-in ballots ahead of the midterms and NATO Secretary-Gen.
